verdict: The R5 attempt and failure quarantine are internally sealed. Exactly one compile and one slot-0 simv ran; zero slots completed. Slot 0 reached the 5,000,000-cycle whole-test watchdog with no PASS token. R5 is permanently exhausted and cannot support RTL cycles, speedup, energy, or paper claims.

root_cause_assessment.proven: The test does not make forward progress to completion within five million core cycles.
root_cause_assessment.not_proven: The sealed log has no phase-local progress markers or waveform, so the exact wait loop is not recoverable from R5 evidence alone.
root_cause_assessment.leading_hypothesis: The sticky load catcher deasserts load_valid with a nonblocking assignment at a posedge after observing the previous sticky state; an always-ready load interface can therefore accept the same descriptor on two consecutive posedges. This is an inference from TB scheduling, not an admitted result.

required_before_any_new_production_ident: Create a new TB file; never edit or retry R5.
Deassert per-axis load_valid at the first negedge after sticky accept so a descriptor cannot be accepted twice.
Add bounded phase-local timeouts and progress markers that identify header/load/run/done stalls.
Run and seal a separate single-slot VCS pilot before authorizing another 960-slot production campaign.
p2_findings: P2-1: Exact deadlock phase is not encoded in the R5 log; the duplicate-load explanation remains a source-level hypothesis until a new-identity diagnostic pilot observes it.
